Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

The top Spiritborn build on the owner's canonical reference: d4builds rates 'Pestilent Swarm' S, its only Spiritborn S [https://d4builds.gg/tierlist/ - 2026-09-16]. The same archetype is Maxroll's 'Counterswarm' (S on the endgame list, A on push) [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/endgame-tier-list - 2026-09-16] [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/push-tier-list - 2026-09-16] and InfinityBuilds' 'Counter Vermin'/'Swarm' (A endgame; page updated September 13, 2026 and still Season 14 gear) [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/tier-list - 2026-09-16]. d4builds' description: 'Pestilent Swarm build that combines the speed of perma Evade and the power of an automatic Poison aura around you. It scales its Counterattack damage via Resolve stacking and uniques like Ring of Writhing Moon.' The endgame layout here is d4builds' ('Pestilent Swarm - Spiritborn (S15)', updated September 14, 2026) [https://d4builds.gg/builds/pestilent-swarm-spiritborn-endgame/?var=0 - 2026-09-16] [https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/d4builds-a3254/databases/(default)/documents/builds/9042e244-490b-45a1-a282-5903123565c4 - 2026-09-16]: Squirt's Blouse, Fists of Fate, Harmony of Ebewaka, Aspect of Infestation weapon, Supremacy + Kinetic Suppression amulet, 5-piece Berú of Balazan's Bite + Protean Heart, and the new Swarm of Storms board - d4builds is the only reference attaching that board to this build. Disagreements: Maxroll's endgame runs Arioc's Needle, legendary chest and gloves, Seal of the Diamond Mind with 4-piece Balazan's Bite + 2-piece Kwatli's Grace, and Start > Convergence > Drive > Bitter Medicine > Prodigy's Tempo (no Swarm of Storms); Maxroll's guide calls it 'one of the top Speedfarmers and close to the top for Pushing' [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/counterswarm-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16] despite 3.2.1 halving Counterattack of the Swarm (150% to 75%, plus an over-damage fix) and fixing the Tzic all-skill damage bug the Season 14 version exploited [https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24295394/celebrate-30-years-of-diablo-in-season-of-hell-s-legacy - 2026-09-16]. Stale guide text: Maxroll's Counterswarm guide still says 'You useTzic for the 6x damage bug' and that Aspect of Supremacy 'can actually go up to 15 stacks'; 3.2.1 fixed Tzic and capped Supremacy at 15 (was 30), so ignore the Tzic line.

Rotation
  1. Cast Ravager, Toxic Skin, Scourge and The Devourer, fire both Counterattack charges to raise the swarms, then hold Rushing Claw to fly through packs; refresh every cooldown as it returns and recast Scourge about every 10 seconds to keep the Balazan's Bite set bonus up.
Variants

Leveling — Cast Ravager, Toxic Skin, Scourge and The Devourer, fire both Counterattack charges, then Rushing Claw through packs and refresh cooldowns as they return (guide SKILL ROTATION). 'Rushing Claw doesn't actually count as an Evade, so you can't use Cem'; 'If you don't cast Rushing Claw 3x in a row, it doesn't trigger Prodigy's Tempo' [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/counterswarm-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16].
Move on when Move to Midgame when Harmony of Ebewaka drops (Bartuc) - the guide's unique priority #2 after the Ring of Writhing Moon - and you have a Legendary seal with a sixth charm slot for Loyalty's Mantle.

Early Endgame — As leveling: Ravager, Toxic Skin, Scourge and The Devourer, both Counterattack charges, then Rushing Claw through packs, refreshing each cooldown as it returns [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/counterswarm-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16].
Move on when Swap to the d4builds layout once you have 30+ ranks in Ravager ('for 4 min. Ferocity', so Rushing Claw: Evolving Claws can refill charges), a Legendary seal with +1 Charm Slot for Protean Heart, and Squirt's Blouse + Fists of Fate.

Late Endgame — d4builds: 'maintain The Devourer, Counterattack, Ravager and Toxic Skin; cast Scourge every 10 sec for the Talisman set buff; spam Rushing Claw' [https://d4builds.gg/builds/pestilent-swarm-spiritborn-endgame/?var=0 - 2026-09-16] [https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/d4builds-a3254/databases/(default)/documents/builds/9042e244-490b-45a1-a282-5903123565c4 - 2026-09-16]. Maxroll: Evolving Claws 'REQUIRES you to cast at enemy targets or it wont work, so you will need to run normally when there aren't targets around'; 'When you start any boss encounter, tower run, etc; you start with zero Resolve. So cast a few evades away from mobs, to build up your stacks.' [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/counterswarm-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16]
Move on when Take the push layout for Pit/Tower once your Harmony, Ring of Writhing Moon and Fists of Fate are Greater-Affixed and you can afford Exploiter's Aspect boots and a Revealing board without Prodigy's Tempo (Maxroll: 'For this variant, you drop Prodigy's Tempo and pick up Revealing').

Pushing — As late endgame: keep The Devourer, Counterattack, Ravager and Toxic Skin up, Scourge every 10 seconds for the Balazan's Bite bonus, Rushing Claw: Evolving Claws at enemy targets, and a few evades away from mobs to bank Resolve before a boss or tower. 'Exploiter's Aspect doesn't apply to bosses, but it will help with getting elites to go unstoppable.' [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/counterswarm-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16]

Stat requirements
  • Minimum Ferocity 4: +15 Ranks to Ravager/Gorilla/Eagle/Focus/Jaguar/Incarnate from boots, amulet, Vex or charms (d4builds)
  • 30+ ranks in Ravager before switching Rushing Claw to Evolving Claws (Maxroll)

How to run them

d4builds' build names 'Raheir, The Shieldbearer', 'Varyana, The Berserker Crone', 'Bloodthirst' [https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/d4builds-a3254/databases/(default)/documents/builds/9042e244-490b-45a1-a282-5903123565c4 - 2026-09-16]. Disagreement: Maxroll Endgame hires Subo ('for his map hacks and increased damage from Scorched Earth & Incendiary Bolt') with Aldkin's Field of Languish on skill cast; Maxroll Push uses 'Rahier's Bastion for additional DR & Unstoppable' [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/counterswarm-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16].

Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

The top Spiritborn build on the owner's canonical reference: d4builds rates 'Pestilent Swarm' S, its only Spiritborn S [https://d4builds.gg/tierlist/ - 2026-09-16]. The same archetype is Maxroll's 'Counterswarm' (S on the endgame list, A on push) [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/endgame-tier-list - 2026-09-16] [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/push-tier-list - 2026-09-16] and InfinityBuilds' 'Counter Vermin'/'Swarm' (A endgame; page updated September 13, 2026 and still Season 14 gear) [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/tier-list - 2026-09-16]. d4builds' description: 'Pestilent Swarm build that combines the speed of perma Evade and the power of an automatic Poison aura around you. It scales its Counterattack damage via Resolve stacking and uniques like Ring of Writhing Moon.' The endgame layout here is d4builds' ('Pestilent Swarm - Spiritborn (S15)', updated September 14, 2026) [https://d4builds.gg/builds/pestilent-swarm-spiritborn-endgame/?var=0 - 2026-09-16] [https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/d4builds-a3254/databases/(default)/documents/builds/9042e244-490b-45a1-a282-5903123565c4 - 2026-09-16]: Squirt's Blouse, Fists of Fate, Harmony of Ebewaka, Aspect of Infestation weapon, Supremacy + Kinetic Suppression amulet, 5-piece Berú of Balazan's Bite + Protean Heart, and the new Swarm of Storms board - d4builds is the only reference attaching that board to this build. Disagreements: Maxroll's endgame runs Arioc's Needle, legendary chest and gloves, Seal of the Diamond Mind with 4-piece Balazan's Bite + 2-piece Kwatli's Grace, and Start > Convergence > Drive > Bitter Medicine > Prodigy's Tempo (no Swarm of Storms); Maxroll's guide calls it 'one of the top Speedfarmers and close to the top for Pushing' [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/counterswarm-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16] despite 3.2.1 halving Counterattack of the Swarm (150% to 75%, plus an over-damage fix) and fixing the Tzic all-skill damage bug the Season 14 version exploited [https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24295394/celebrate-30-years-of-diablo-in-season-of-hell-s-legacy - 2026-09-16]. Stale guide text: Maxroll's Counterswarm guide still says 'You useTzic for the 6x damage bug' and that Aspect of Supremacy 'can actually go up to 15 stacks'; 3.2.1 fixed Tzic and capped Supremacy at 15 (was 30), so ignore the Tzic line.

Rotation
  1. Cast Ravager, Toxic Skin, Scourge and The Devourer, fire both Counterattack charges to raise the swarms, then hold Rushing Claw to fly through packs; refresh every cooldown as it returns and recast Scourge about every 10 seconds to keep the Balazan's Bite set bonus up.
Variants

Leveling — Cast Ravager, Toxic Skin, Scourge and The Devourer, fire both Counterattack charges, then Rushing Claw through packs and refresh cooldowns as they return (guide SKILL ROTATION). 'Rushing Claw doesn't actually count as an Evade, so you can't use Cem'; 'If you don't cast Rushing Claw 3x in a row, it doesn't trigger Prodigy's Tempo' [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/counterswarm-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16].
Move on when Move to Midgame when Harmony of Ebewaka drops (Bartuc) - the guide's unique priority #2 after the Ring of Writhing Moon - and you have a Legendary seal with a sixth charm slot for Loyalty's Mantle.

Early Endgame — As leveling: Ravager, Toxic Skin, Scourge and The Devourer, both Counterattack charges, then Rushing Claw through packs, refreshing each cooldown as it returns [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/counterswarm-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16].
Move on when Swap to the d4builds layout once you have 30+ ranks in Ravager ('for 4 min. Ferocity', so Rushing Claw: Evolving Claws can refill charges), a Legendary seal with +1 Charm Slot for Protean Heart, and Squirt's Blouse + Fists of Fate.

Late Endgame — d4builds: 'maintain The Devourer, Counterattack, Ravager and Toxic Skin; cast Scourge every 10 sec for the Talisman set buff; spam Rushing Claw' [https://d4builds.gg/builds/pestilent-swarm-spiritborn-endgame/?var=0 - 2026-09-16] [https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/d4builds-a3254/databases/(default)/documents/builds/9042e244-490b-45a1-a282-5903123565c4 - 2026-09-16]. Maxroll: Evolving Claws 'REQUIRES you to cast at enemy targets or it wont work, so you will need to run normally when there aren't targets around'; 'When you start any boss encounter, tower run, etc; you start with zero Resolve. So cast a few evades away from mobs, to build up your stacks.' [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/counterswarm-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16]
Move on when Take the push layout for Pit/Tower once your Harmony, Ring of Writhing Moon and Fists of Fate are Greater-Affixed and you can afford Exploiter's Aspect boots and a Revealing board without Prodigy's Tempo (Maxroll: 'For this variant, you drop Prodigy's Tempo and pick up Revealing').

Pushing — As late endgame: keep The Devourer, Counterattack, Ravager and Toxic Skin up, Scourge every 10 seconds for the Balazan's Bite bonus, Rushing Claw: Evolving Claws at enemy targets, and a few evades away from mobs to bank Resolve before a boss or tower. 'Exploiter's Aspect doesn't apply to bosses, but it will help with getting elites to go unstoppable.' [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/counterswarm-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16]

Stat requirements
  • Minimum Ferocity 4: +15 Ranks to Ravager/Gorilla/Eagle/Focus/Jaguar/Incarnate from boots, amulet, Vex or charms (d4builds)
  • 30+ ranks in Ravager before switching Rushing Claw to Evolving Claws (Maxroll)

Harmony of Ebewaka

Unique Helm

  • According to your secondary Spirit Hall choice, your Skills are all additionally Jaguar, Eagle, Gorilla, or Centipede Skills.
  • Your Skills deal 25 – 30% increased damage per Spirit type they have.

Only Ebewaka has walked amid a dozen Guardians. In death, they waged war for his spirit, yet none prevailed. Thus, the Guardians shared dominion, granting Ebewaka to roam freely amid all their realms.

Ring of Writhing Moon

Unique Ring

Squirt's Blouse

Unique Chest Armor

  • While not taking damage, you take up to 50% more damage and deal up to 35 – 50% more damage. This bonus is reset upon losing Life.

It looks like the blouse of a street urchin with a crude stone pendant. But the inside is lined with hidden pockets and sinister sheathes. And on the back of the pendant? A old runic word: "Kantwirt."

Fists of Fate

Unique Gloves

  • Your attacks randomly deal 1% to 250 – 300% of their normal damage.

"Will you let fear cheat you, or will you risk everything to find understanding? After all, death is simply the coin with which we purchase life." - Zurke

Loyalty's Mantle

Unique Helm

  • While your Spirit Hall choices match:
  • Their bonuses are 100% more potent.
  • Skills of their Base Spirit gain 50 – 60% Vigor Cost Reduction.
  • Skills of their Base Spirit gain 50 – 60% Cooldown Reduction.

During a Trial of Mists, a small spirit noticed an unclaimed boy. In pity, it spared him. "I will follow you always," vowed the boy. He remained true even after Ah Bulan called the spirit home.

Iconic skillRaheir

Cooldown: 25 seconds

Ground Slam

Core skillRaheir

Cooldown: 11 seconds

Weapon: Round Shield
